item.title: Report: Likud offering Gantz ministerial position
item.description:
As part of discussions over Benny Gantz potentially joining the Likud party, he was reportedly offered a ministerial position in the current government as a gesture intended to strengthen the "national unity government" campaign, Kan News reported.
Likud stated that "Benny Gantz has not received an offer of a reserved spot on the party's electoral list."
The Blue and White party stated that Gantz is not interested in "jobs, honors, or reserved spots," and that the only relevant option from its perspective is the establishment of a Zionist government spanning political blocs.

item.title: WZO chair denounces Green Party resolution
item.description: Yaakov Hagoel,Chairman World Zionist Organization, denounced the decision of the UK Green Party equating Zionism with racism. "The Green Party of England and Wales's decision to adopt a resolution defining Zionism as racism is a shameful, scandalous resolution tainted with severe Antisemitism."

item.title: IDF eliminates Hamas commander, observer
item.description:
Earlier today (Sunday), the IDF struck in the Khan Yunis area in the Gaza Strip and eliminated Muad Gamal Abu Nuseira, a commander in Hamas’ military wing.
Yesterday (Saturday), in an additional strike, the IDF eliminated Mahmoud Ibrahim Dib Alyan, a terrorist in Hamas’ observation unit.
Recently, the terrorist was identified advancing terrorist activities against IDF troops in the area of the Yellow Line and working to restore Hamas’ capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire agreement. The terrorist was eliminated in an aerial strike.

item.title: Winter responds to No. 2's past support for Palestinian State: Proud of his ability to change
item.description:
Amcha Yisrael chairman Ofer Winter commented on an old video in which the party's number two candidate, Yoseph Haddad, is heard expressing support for the establishment of a Palestinian state.
"I am proud of Yoseph Haddad, a Golani soldier who was wounded in combat in Lebanon and is Israel's strongest advocate," Winter said.
He added: "I am proud of a person's ability to change his positions in the right direction. Some people look at the past; we learn from the past to correct the future."

item.title: Suspected Ebola case at Sheba Medical Center
item.description:
The Ministry of Health has announced that a suspected Ebola case has been tested in Israel, after a person who returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo developed a fever upon his return. The ministry emphasizes that, at this stage, this is only a suspicion, and the test results are expected to be received today.
The person was transferred to Sheba Medical Center and is being treated in isolation according to procedures. At the same time, an epidemiological investigation is being conducted to locate people who came into contact with him. Anyone who does not receive a call from the Ministry of Health is not required to take action.
